messages:
Alex G: Quick follow-up from yesterday's high‑p95 latency incident on the generation path. Postmortem live here: https://redwood.local/postmortems/INC-2026-042. I want to push a short list of SLO/SLA guardrail changes + action owners so we don't keep seeing the same recurrence. TL;DR: raise p95 SLO temporarily, add per-pool queue/p95 panels, tighten canary rollback rules, update runbook. Assignments below — please ack or propose edits.

Priya R: Ack. I can add the Grafana panels. Want them by pool and model tag. ETA 48h.

Alex G: Thanks. Sample PromQL for p95 by pool/model (use histogram/summary depending on metric):
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gen_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool, model))
```
Also queue depth: `sum(queue_depth) by (pool)` with a per-pool threshold.

Jordan C: I'll investigate autoscaler oscillation and GPU pool headroom. My hunch: bursty small requests + KV cache misses cause transient queueing. I'll gather traces/profiles and propose a throttling/scale-delay tweak. ETA 72h.

Maya L: On runbook/alerts: I'll add a page that says when to page vs notify. Proposal: page when p95 > 300ms for 3m AND queue_depth > 5 for any dedicated pool. Add a non-paging warning at p95 > 250ms for 5m. I'll update runbook + Ops playbook in 24h.

Sam T: For canaries — propose we pause/rollback if error budget burns > 30% in 1h or absolute p95 > 350ms. I can add automation to the release pipeline to stop canaries and trigger rollback. Need API token for pipeline control. ETA 1 week for automation, manual guard in 24h.

Alex G: I've granted Sam pipeline token. Also proposing this temporary SLO tweak: generation route p95 target increase from 200ms -> 250ms for 14 days while we deploy fixes and collect data. We'll rebaseline after 30 days or sooner if metrics normalise. This is to avoid noisy paging and allow controlled remediation. Thoughts?

Priya R: Fine with temporary change. Heads-up that billing/usage dashboards will reflect this; I'll sync with Finance.

Jordan C: One more thing — I want a dashboard panel that correlates p95 with queue_depth and autoscale events (scale_up/scale_down) so we can see causality. Priya can you add a combined panel with annotations for scaling events?

Priya R: Yep, I'll add annotations from the autoscaler event feed.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 postmortem published: https://redwood.local/postmortems/INC-2026-042. Notifying channel: #eng-oncall.

Maya L: Quick checklist summary (I'll post to the runbook after):
- Temporary SLO change: p95 200 -> 250ms (14d) — OWNER: Alex G — ACTION: apply SLO guardrail + note in SLA docs (today)
- Dashboard: per-pool p95, queue depth, autoscale annotation — OWNER: Priya R — ETA: 48h
- Autoscale tuning + root cause trace/profiles — OWNER: Jordan C — ETA: 72h
- Runbook + paging thresholds update — OWNER: Maya L — ETA: 24h
- Canary rollback automation + manual guard — OWNER: Sam T — ETA: 1w (manual guard 24h)

Alex G: I'll open a short JIRA to track these items and tag owners (JIRA-4667). Please add time estimates in the ticket and update when items are done. We'll regroup next Tuesday for status — 30 min. :thumbsup:

Sam T: Acked and noted. I'll start with a manual canary stop script and post it here once tested.

Jordan C: I'll attach traces to the JIRA when I have them. If we see the same pattern across pools, propose a platform-wide throttle change for small requests; will test in staging.

Priya R: FYI I'm adding a new 'p95_by_pool' panel to the SLO dashboard and a heatmap for model-level spikes.

Maya L: I'll add the paging rule to Alertmanager and set runbook link in the alert.

Alex G: Thanks team. If anyone cannot meet the ETA ping me directly. We'll reconvene after the dashboard is live.

Priya R: done — pushed panel draft to grafana-dev, sharing link: https://grafana.dev/d/abcd1234/p95-by-pool (wip).

Alex G: Received. Closing thread for now — reopen if any blocker.
